OUTCOME OF RIGHTS ISSUE COMMITTEE MEETING OF PRATIK PANELS LIMITED HELD ON 15TH JULY, 2026

analysis.summary: Pratik Panels Limited reported financial results for the year ended March 31, 2025, with total income of Rs. 334.11 lakhs and a net profit after tax of Rs. 25.59 lakhs. The company engaged in trading activities and proposed a corporate rebranding, including a change of name to "TREEGATE AGRITRADE LIMITED" and an expansion of its object clause into agricultural products. Furthermore, the company increased its authorized share capital, adjusted foreign investment limits for NRIs and OCIs, and made several changes to its board of directors and key managerial personnel.

margins_costs.claim: The company cited reduction in revenue, marginal increase in expenses, and less profit margin as reasons for inadequate profits.
margins_costs.quote: Due to reduction in revenue, marginal increase in expenses and less profit margin, the profit is inadequate for payment of remuneration to executive directors of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25 due to accumulated losses.
capital_allocation.quote: In view of the accumulated losses of the Company, your directors do not recommend any dividend for the year 2024-25 and no amount has been transferred to Reserve during the year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed an increase in the authorized share capital from INR 7,50,00,000 to INR 10,00,00,000, and subsequently to INR 12,50,00,000.
capital_allocation.quote: consent of the shareholders of the Company be and is hereby accorded for the increase in the authorised share capital of the Company FROM INR 7,50,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Seven Crore Fifty Lakhs Only), divided into 7,50,00,000 (Seven Crore Fifity) equity shares of INR 1/- (Indian Rupee One Only) each TO INR 10,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees Ten Crore Only), divided into 12,50,00,000 (Twelve Crore Fifty Lakhs) equity shares of INR 1/- (Indian Rupee One Only) each.

capital_allocation.claim: The funds raised were entirely utilized according to the object of the issue.
capital_allocation.quote: The funds raised were entirely utilized to as per the object of the issue.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
